## Change

Explain the user problem, resulting behavior, and related issue.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and results. Distinguish automated checks from manual
verification and list anything not verified.

## Visual evidence

For visible UI or website changes, embed real screenshots with descriptive alt
text. Include light/dark examples when appearance is affected, and before/after
images when they explain a fix. For drag or multi-step behavior, add a short
recording or a reproducible walkthrough. State the platform and example used.
Use fictional data. Prefer uploaded attachments or commit-pinned image links
that survive branch deletion. For nonvisual changes, write "Not applicable".

## Limitations

Mention remaining work and important design tradeoffs, if any.
